Markets.title: Dollar treads water as Fed hike bets pared on benign US inflation
Markets.summary: The dollar stalled on Thursday after benign U.S. inflation data caused traders to scale back bets on a near-term Federal Reserve interest rate hike. Despite this daily pause, the dollar index remained on track for a weekly gain.

Markets.title: South Korea's Kospi swings from bear to bull market in just a month. Is AI trade regaining strength?
Markets.summary: South Korea's KOSPI index surged over 31% from its July low, transitioning from a bear to a bull market in just a month. This rapid recovery was driven by a sharp rebound in major chipmakers Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, reviving optimism in the artificial intelligence sector.

Markets.title: Muthoot Fincorp files draft papers for Rs 3,000 cr IPO to boost capital base
Markets.summary: Muthoot Fincorp has filed draft papers with SEBI for an initial public offering of up to Rs 3,000 crore. The non-banking financial company aims to use the IPO proceeds to strengthen its capital base and fund future business growth.

Markets.title: Astral shares rally 10% following Q1 results; Citi sees target price at Rs 1,900, Nuvama upgrades stock to 'Buy'
Markets.summary: Astral shares surged nearly 10% following a 51.8% year-over-year increase in profit for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027. Following the strong results, Nuvama upgraded the stock to "Buy" and Citi maintained its "Buy" rating with a target price of Rs 1,900.

Markets.title: State Bank of India's successful dollar debt sale prompts Bank of Baroda to test waters, bankers say
Markets.summary: Encouraged by State Bank of India's recent success, Bank of Baroda is planning a dual-tranche dollar bond sale with three and five-year maturities. Indian banks are increasingly pursuing these cost-effective foreign-currency borrowings to support their operations and financial requirements.

Markets.title: US refiners ramp up buybacks as Iran war boosts fuel margins
Markets.summary: US refiners Marathon Petroleum, Phillips 66, and Valero Energy reported combined second-quarter profits of $12.6 billion driven by supply disruptions and higher refining margins. The companies returned $6.3 billion to shareholders through buybacks and dividends, which was more than double the amount from the previous year.

Geo-Political.title: Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine, Nobel Peace Prize winner tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Nobel Peace Prize winner Dmitry Muratov told the BBC that Russian President Vladimir Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine. Muratov stated that after four years of war, the Kremlin leader is now only capable of destroying Ukraine rather than conquering it.

Geo-Political.title: Israeli settlers besieging Palestinian families in West Bank village
Geo-Political.summary: About a dozen Israeli settlers are besieging two Palestinian families in a West Bank village. Israeli security forces have reportedly withdrawn from the site, where the families have been trapped since Sunday.

Geo-Political.title: Ebola outbreak on track to be deadliest ever, WHO chief says
Geo-Political.summary: The WHO chief states that the Ebola outbreak, declared on May 15, is on track to become the deadliest in history. This epidemic has already caused over 2,000 deaths and thousands of additional reported cases.

Geo-Political.title: Three men will be executed on the same day as death penalties rise in US
Geo-Political.summary: Three men in the United States are scheduled to be executed on the same day. This event highlights a rising number of death penalties driven by just one state, despite growing overall opposition to capital punishment.

Geo-Political.title: Why are 'human fridges' being sold in Japan?
Geo-Political.summary: Japan is currently experiencing extreme summer heat waves. To help people cope with the high temperatures, portable cooling devices known as "human fridges" are being sold in the country.

Geo-Political.title: BTS star V reveals hearing loss battle during livestream
Geo-Political.summary: BTS member V shared during a livestream that he has been dealing with hearing loss for more than two years. He publicly disclosed the health issue for the first time this week.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation slowed to 3.4% year-on-year in July amid fluctuating oil prices. This increase matched analyst expectations and could give the Federal Reserve more flexibility regarding interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, surpassing the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by rising food and fuel prices, compounded by the risks of elevated global oil prices.

Data & Insights.title: Fitch retains India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for 20th year, forecasts GDP growth at 6.4% — Here's what it means
Data & Insights.summary: Fitch Ratings has maintained India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for the twentieth consecutive year due to strong economic growth prospects. However, the agency also highlighted potential fiscal risks stemming from youth protests over employment issues.

Data & Insights.title: The Sanjeev Sanyal interview: A new age of ideas for India
Data & Insights.summary: Sanjeev Sanyal states that artificial intelligence is making traditional university models obsolete. He also notes that India's primary challenge is ensuring workforce employability rather than simply creating jobs.

Data & Insights.title: India retail inflation likely remained unchanged at 4.4% in July: Mint poll
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation in July is expected to have stayed flat at 4.4%. A favorable base effect and contained underlying inflation offset broad-based increases in food prices.

Data & Insights.title: 'From  ₹14.12 lakh crore to  ₹23.40 lakh crore in 5 years': How govt is tightening the tax net
Data & Insights.summary: Over the past five years, the Indian government's stricter tax compliance measures have helped increase the number of Income Tax Return filers by 24% to 8.67 crore. During the same period, direct tax collections grew by 66%, rising from ₹14.12 lakh crore to ₹23.40 lakh crore.

India.title: SSC Stenographer 2026 Exam Dates Out: September Shift, Schedule Details
India.summary: The Staff Selection Commission will hold the Combined Hindi Translators exam on September 8, 2026. This examination is for recruitment positions within central government offices.

India.title: APPSC Group-I Valuation Under SIT Scanner, Serious Irregularities Flagged
India.summary: A Special Investigation Team is examining serious irregularities in the digital evaluation of the APPSC Group-1 Mains exams held in December 2020. The APPSC had initially shortlisted 326 candidates based on these results before the valuation came under scrutiny.

India.title: Did Insta Algorithm Boost Jantar Mantar And Mute Jharkhand? NDTV Data Analysis
India.summary: BJP leader Amit Malviya shared an NDTV data analysis questioning whether Meta's Instagram algorithm selectively boosts content about Jantar Mantar while suppressing posts about Jharkhand. The report examines allegations that Meta manipulates Indian public discourse by favoring certain topics over others.

India.title: Central Government Provided 1.09 Crore Scholarships For Post-Matric, Higher Education
India.summary: The central government is providing 1.09 crore scholarships for post-matric and higher education. This financial support will be distributed during the 2025-26 fiscal year.

India.title: Row Over 'Shuddhikaran' Of Venue After Mallikarjun Kharge's Rally In Uttarakhand
India.summary: Uttarakhand Congress chief Ganesh Godiyal claimed that a BJP-affiliated group performed a "shuddhikaran" (purification) ceremony at a venue after a rally held by Mallikarjun Kharge. The BJP strongly denied any association with the Shri Ram Sena group that conducted the ritual.

India.title: Karnataka Bandh Over Cauvery Gets "Moral Support", Bus, School Ops Normal
India.summary: A Karnataka bandh over the Cauvery water issue received only moral support rather than active participation from transport unions. Consequently, bus services and school operations remained normal across the state.

General.title: Results day dawns for A-level, T-level and BTec students
General.summary: Results day has arrived for students receiving their A-level, T-level, and BTec qualifications. Another record number of these students are expected to secure places at their first-choice universities.

General.title: Once-in-a-generation solar eclipse wows millions in UK and Europe
General.summary: A once-in-a-generation solar eclipse recently captivated millions of people across the UK and Europe. The Moon covered more than 95% of the Sun in Cornwall, while parts of Spain experienced a total eclipse.
